security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI M-mode code writes to SPMP CSRs (via miselect/mireg/mireg2 indirect access, mpmpdeleg CSR to delegate PMP entries, or spmpen CSR to activate/deactivate entries) to configure S-level physical memory protection, then returns control to S-mode or U-mode without first executing SFENCE.VMA with rs1=x0 and rs2=x0 to synchronize the SPMP state with subsequent memory accesses in less-privileged modes.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: CSR write to mpmpdeleg|spmpen|miselect (followed by mireg|mireg2) without a subsequent SFENCE\.VMA x0,\s*x0 before mret/sret or any control transfer to S/U-mode
security_spec.summary: SPMP CSR writes (mpmpdeleg delegation, spmpen activation, or indirect SPMP entry configuration via miselect/mireg) are explicitly not ordered with respect to subsequent memory accesses per the Sspmp spec; missing SFENCE.VMA after such writes in M-mode firmware creates a window where stale SPMP rules apply to S/U-mode execution
